details.description: Whisper large-v3-turbo is OpenAI's speed-optimized speech recognition model, a pruned version of large-v3 that reduces the decoder from 32 layers to 4 while keeping the same encoder. It has 809 million parameters and supports transcription across 99 languages, trading a small amount of accuracy for substantially faster inference than large-v3. On Groq it is offered for transcription only; unlike large-v3, Groq's docs state it does not support the speech translation task.
advantages: Hugging Face's model card reports a mean word error rate of 7.83, close to large-v3's 7.44 despite an 8x reduction in decoder layers.
Groq reports a real-time processing speed factor of 216x, faster than the 189x it reports for whisper-large-v3.
Uses the same encoder as whisper-large-v3, retaining most of its multilingual transcription accuracy at a fraction of the decoding cost.
disadvantages: Does not support the speech translation task on Groq; only transcription is available.
Slightly higher mean word error rate than whisper-large-v3 (7.83 vs 7.44, per Hugging Face's evaluation table).
Prone to hallucinating text not present in the audio, and word error rates vary across languages and demographic groups, per OpenAI's Whisper model documentation.
use_cases: Real-time applications such as live captioning, meeting transcription, and voice assistants.
High-volume batch transcription, including customer service call processing.
Cost-conscious transcription for startups and educational platforms.

notes: Bud's facts list only the /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint, matching Groq's documentation that this model does not support the translation endpoint. Parameter count, decoder-layer reduction, and mean WER are from the Hugging Face model card; OpenAI has not published a dedicated model-card.md for the turbo variant on GitHub, so the repo link is used only for the general Whisper codebase. WER figures are reported in prose (not evaluations) since WER is lower-is-better. Language support is given only as a count ('99 languages'), so languages is left empty.
